sector_note: Record decisions you have made about sectors (for example state-owned employers) and the date, so they are not re-asked.
dealbreakers: mandatory degree or licence not held
posting older than 45 days with no evidence it is open
employer or ATS page shows the role closed, even if a job board still shows Apply
sources: employer careers pages and ATS boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters)
validation_rules: Named employer; open on own careers or ATS page; no evidence older than 45 days (mark 'date unverified' if undated); aggregator-only or unnamed-client roles are 'conditional', not counted

hard_requirement_screen.rule: Read the posting's essential requirements against profile/master-cv.md before scoring. Separate what the ad treats as a hard minimum from what it treats as preferred, then grade the gap.

tiers.when: a mandatory degree, licence or registration the CV does not hold
the ad states a hard minimum ('must have', 'required', 'minimum') for years or a named discipline and the CV clearly fails it
tiers.effect: cap the score at 55; name the gap first in the ledger gap text; no preparation without the user's OK

tiers.when: a gap of size or depth rather than kind (a larger team than you have led, a neighbouring sector, one tool missing from a stack)
tiers.effect: deduct 5 to 10 points and flag it in the gap text; no cap

tiers.when: anything the ad calls preferred, advantageous, a bonus or a differentiator

hard_requirement_screen.always: Say which tier applies and show the raw rubric score next to any capped or deducted score, so the user can overrule it.

liveness_check.rule: A role is open only if the employer or ATS page is open, not just the job board.
liveness_check.linkedin: Wait about 6 seconds before reading the page; the closed notice appears late. For 'apply on company website' roles, open the employer link and confirm an Apply button and no 'closed' text.
liveness_check.recheck: Recheck before preparing a role and again on the day of submission.

response_flags: recruiter ad with unnamed client: conditional, flag client unnamed
posting states an equity or demographic preference: note it in the gap text, do not decide for the user
employer limits on applications (for example at most 3 roles in 12 months): spend them on the best fits
reapply_rule: Do not resubmit a role the employer has rejected, or apply twice through two routes, without the user's approval and a materially changed CV or letter.
